description: The locations of this workspace, each with the connected accounts that belong to it, and the accounts that belong to none. To post to a location, use the ids of its accounts as the destinations of the draft. Part of Pro.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.
